name: table checks
build: 1table@v 1 id: must match [A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.-]*
1table@v 1 version: must be letters, digits, '.', '_' or '-'
1table@v 1 outputs.who: outputs must be bool, int, string, decimal, money, date or lists of them
1table@v 1 outputs.many: outputs must be bool, int, string, decimal, money, date or lists of them
1table@v 1 rules: a decision table needs at least one rule
1table@v 1 inputs.businessDate: reserved name; every decision receives businessDate implicitly (DecisionRef.asOf, else the engine clock)
